title: Record the owned-zero forward-mass screen
body:
## Summary
- The nine-stage idle schedule has mass `1342656`, and four reverse calls charged at two rank-7 moves per port add `198912`.
- The remaining room in capacity `1818624` is `277056`, so the forward mass that makes the zero-saving bill exactly one is `277056 / 160 = 8658/5`.
- Any larger forward mass exceeds one before saving is added. No new kappa, and the owned-scratch word is not replayed.
